mn21:7.10: para. 7. See Sutta 65, para. 2. (not in this selection). odhasta—lying ready: P.T.S. Dict. gives only ‘fallen down, scattered’ which is wrong in this context and conflicts with the Comy. Cf. M. vol iii, 97.
mn21:8.4: para. 8. tacchetvā—cut down; see Sutta 5, para. 31. (not in this selection)
mn21:9.39: para. 9. aggulasūci--rendered here as ‘rolling-pin’ though it might be a bar for a door-fastening.
mn21:12.12: para. 13. yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assa—eventually this man would reap weariness and disappointment: the phrase recurs at M. vol. i, 241 and elsewhere in the Suttas. The use of yāvadeva is idiomatic.
mn21:20.1: para. 25. corā carakā—bandits savagely: cf. same phrase at Samyutta no. III, I. Alternative rendering: ‘Even if common bandits.’
